title: Art. 5.3.24.1 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 5 - Lights, 5.3.24 Apron floodlighting, Application, 5.3.24.1
content:
Recommendation.— Apron floodlighting should be provided on an apron, on a de-icing/anti-icing facility and on a designated isolated aircraft parking position intended to be used at night.

Note 1. — Where a de-icing/anti-icing facility is located in close proximity to the runway and permanent floodlighting could be confusing to pilots, other means of illumination of the facility may be required.
Note 2. — The designation of an isolated aircraft parking position is specified in 3.14.
Note 3. — Guidance on apron floodlighting is given in the Aerodrome Design Manual (Doc 9157), Part 4.
